headline_marked: Moove raises [[$250M]] to operate Waymo robotaxis
headline: Moove raises $250M to operate Waymo robotaxis
summary: The company aims to become the backbone of the robotaxi industry, expanding its fleet management services to autonomous vehicles.
details: Moove has secured $250 million in Series C funding at a $2.1 billion valuation, with Mubadala Investment Company leading the round. This capital injection is earmarked for scaling its autonomous vehicle fleet management business.

The company, which already operates a 42,000-vehicle ride-hailing fleet, is expanding into autonomous vehicle operations. Moove currently serves as the fleet operator for Waymo in Phoenix, Miami, and Las Vegas, with plans to expand to London.

Moove's strategy involves owning and operating autonomous vehicles, addressing a gap where AV developers and marketplaces often don't want to "own the metal." Their experience in fleet management and vehicle financing positions them to manage the complex logistics of robotaxi fleets.

The funding will also support the development of "Nests," automated depots designed for 24/7 operation, utilizing robotics for charging, maintenance, and servicing of autonomous vehicles. Moove plans to eventually purchase the robotaxis it operates, using debt financing.

While Moove doesn't yet own the Waymo vehicles it operates, it has already acquired robotaxis from another AV developer, though the company remains undisclosed. Moove's ultimate vision is to manage hundreds of thousands of autonomous vehicles.
